name: Roman
title: Head Blacksmith

villagemaster/30897.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: During Lionel Hunter's reign, Innadril was never engulfed by war. That great man singlehandedly defeated that frightful Fafurion's Golem army, you know... But now it seems as though that long-held peace is over. Just look at the orders for and sales of weaponry... Ah, trouble…

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30897-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: I've been taking a break these past couple of days. I feel as though I deserve it. So whatever business brings you here better be good.

links.text: Ask his opinion about Dr. Helvetica.

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30897-04.html.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: Do you have any more business with me? I've said all I have to say. Unless there's something else, stop bothering me.

Q00351_BlackSwan/30897-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: Hmm... This is definitely the signature of Iason Heine. What would you like to trade for it?

Q00351_BlackSwan/30897-02.html.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: Are you helping Iason Heine defeat the Tasaba lizardmen? Bring me the bills he gives you, I will exchange them for useful items.

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30897-02.html.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: It is an undeniable certainty that transforming that useless Field of Silence into an industrial zone will make life here more prosperous. Once that happens, I'm going to take all the money I've saved and build my own factory out there. Then it will be bye-bye work and hello …

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30897-03.html.text: Head Blacksmith Roman: I'm serious as the grave. What good is that land doing completely undeveloped? Does that reed field make money? Is it benefiting anybody at all? Dr. Helvetica just wants to ulitize the land... give it a purpose. Developing on that land won't just make him money, it will make …
